# G7 replay fixtures

These three complete proposals and intent summaries were prepared for G7 on
2026-10-08 from the named templates' README rules. They reuse the templates'
shape/bindings, genesis, effect payloads and law metadata, with rewritten case
guards. This is a visible, inspectable rederivation fixture, not blind synthesis
or evidence that an automated model inferred a specification from prose.

The initial example files are read unchanged from `templates/<name>/tests/decision-examples.txt`.
Their comments record the original AI drafting/review and owner acceptance
(durable-counter: 2026-09-23; inventory-reservation/account-lockout: 2026-09-24).
This test preserves that recorded provenance; it does not authenticate it.

Additional F2 questions, if any, are answered in the test by a **simulated
supplier** using the retained original template contract, through the existing
library review API. Expectations never come from the submitted proposal.
These additional labels are not human-reviewed or real owner interaction.
The test establishes workflow mechanics and decision preservation relative to
those fixtures. A real drafting session must supply its own labels and review
its assumptions. Finalizing is not adoption or publication authority.
